question_cn: 本题局面中，白方最好的中间招是什么？（黑马Na5无根）
question_en: What is White's best intermezzo in this position? (Black's knight on a5 is loose.)

options.text_en: Capture the loose knight immediately with Bxa5

options.text_cn: 先Qf1+将军，黑王应将后再Bxa5吃马
options.text_en: Play Qf1+ first; after the black king responds to check, capture the knight with Bxa5
Give check with Nd7+ first, then return to capture the knight

options.text_cn: 先Qxa5直接吃马，再后撤防守
options.text_en: Capture the knight immediately with Qxa5, then retreat to defend

explanation_cn: 黑马Na5是无根子（挂子）。白方若直接Bxa5，只赚一马；但先Qf1+将军，黑王被迫应将，无法救马，再Bxa5——同样赢马，但还多了一步主动将军的先手！挂子是中间招奏效的常见前提：无根子无法逃跑，让插入的强迫步更有威力。
explanation_en: Black's knight on a5 is loose. If White takes it with Bxa5 immediately, White wins the knight. But Qf1+ first forces the black king to answer the check and leaves no time to save the knight; White can then play Bxa5 and still win it, with an extra forcing move. A loose piece often makes an intermezzo especially effective because it cannot escape while the opponent responds.
